provenance.title: Corner distance and door swing
provenance.covers: Gap to corners and the free space a door needs to open. Written from general knowledge in our own words, not copied from the sources.

sources.name: Approved Document M: Access to and use of buildings (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. Smallest gap between a door frame and a room corner.
Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. Smallest gap between a window and a room corner.
Typical guideline, check local rules. A door opens into the room and needs a free square as wide as the door. Step in metres for trying other places.
